climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Sémillon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A grouping within Bordeaux that holds the Bordeaux Supérieur appellation. Bordeaux's rules allow Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cot and Carmenère for red, plus Sauvignon, Sémillon and Muscadelle. The Gironde area grows mostly Merlot (58 percent) and Cabernet Sauvignon (20).
